final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by reading each log entry and filtering only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I converted the timestamps to UTC in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. For each entry, I extracted the message after the last ' | ' separator on the first line. I also accounted for any repeated messages indicated by lines like '-- last message repeated N times --' following the entry, summing these to get the repeat_count. Finally, I aggregated counts by service and wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the required JSON structure and format.
